card.name: The word percent after a number
card.fires_on: The word 'percent' or 'cent' (also '%') right after a spelled-out or numeric amount like Eighty, 100, or 95 per. It often starts a sentence about a share of patients or a supply.

modes.label: Spelled-out number then percent
modes.description: A written-out number such as Eighty or Seventy-six is followed by 'percent' at the start of a statement about patients.
modes.example: Seventy-six<< percent>> of the patients experienced an increase in either

modes.label: Per cent split spelling
modes.description: The 'cent' part of 'per cent' after a numeral in news-style text.
modes.example: the world could produce 95 per<< cent>> of the electricity it needs from sustainable sources

card.plain: It fires on the word 'percent' (or per cent) right after a number, as in 'Eighty percent of patients'.
